source.name: Wowhead Midnight Season 2 Tier Set Overview and item pages
source.scope: All 13 class sets have verified base item IDs and slots. Only Shaman has source-backed difficulty-variant stats; other tier pieces remain metadata-only and are excluded from optimization until stats and upgrade variants are verified.

scoringPolicy: Bonus descriptions are informational. Do not assign numeric optimization weights unless separately verified by simulation or an explicit source-backed profile.

specs: Blood
When you Death Strike, gain a stack of Blood Debt, increasing Strength by 0.5%, up to 5.0%. When Blood Debt reaches 10 stacks, your next Marrowrend consumes it granting 10% Strength for 10 sec.
When consuming Blood Debt, your next Marrowrend generates 3 additional Boneshield and deals Shadow damage to your target and nearby enemies.
Frost
Each time Remorseless Winter damages at least 1 enemy, gain Freezing Tempest which grants 2% attack speed and 4% increased Icy Death Torrent damage for 5 sec, stacking.
Remorseless Winter deals damage 25% more frequently, and Freezing Tempest lasts 5 sec longer.
Unholy
Your Magus of the Dead and Lord of the Dead cast a more powerful Necrotic Bolt instead of Frostbolt, and Withering Grasp instead of Shadow Bolt.
Necrotic Bolt's damage and Withering Grasp's damage are increased by 130% against targets below 35% health.
Devourer
Harvesting 4 or more Soul Fragments with Reap has a 20% chance to make your next Consume instant and explode in a Soulburst.
Soulburst generates 8 Soul Fragments and grants Moment of Craving. Reap deals 20% increased damage.
Havoc
Blade Dance, Chaos Strike, and Essence Break have 12% increased damage.
Essence Break applies and benefits from Cycle of Hatred, has 35% increased initial strike damage, and 2 sec increased duration.
Vengeance
Sigil of Flame damage over time is increased by 50%. Soul Cleave increases Sigil of Flame duration on your primary target by 2 sec.
Immolation Aura and Sigil of Spite deal 100% increased damage against targets affected by Sigil of Flame.
Balance
Starsurge damage increased by 20%. Starfall also deals instant Astral damage to all valid enemies in range when cast.
Your damage is increased by 10% while in any Eclipse, waning to 2% at the midpoint then waxing back to 10%.
Feral
When Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane or Berserk ends, you deal 10% increased damage for 0.75 sec per combo point spent during it.
Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane or Berserk lasts 10 sec longer.
Guardian
Thrash has a 20% chance to make your next Mangle deal 100% increased damage.
Thrash calls up 3 thorns that deal Nature damage and extends Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc or Berserk by up to 5 sec.
Restoration
Rejuvenation has a 15% chance to grant Genesis, causing all heal-over-time effects to heal for 15% more for 8 sec. Applications may overlap.
Nature's Swiftness, Tranquility, and Incarnation: Tree of Life or Convoke the Spirits have a 100% chance to grant Genesis, whose duration is increased by 4 sec.
Augmentation
Upheaval's cooldown is reduced by 10 sec.
Upheaval magnifies Fate Mirror effects for 8 sec, increasing echoed damage to 45%.
Devastation
Shattering Star damage is increased by 50% and always casts as if maximum empower level was reached.
Causality reduces remaining cooldown of empower spells by an additional 0.1 sec each proc. Eternity Surge deals 10% increased damage.
Preservation
Consuming Essence Burst sends a Living Flame at your target at 100% effectiveness, or a nearby injured target if the target is full health.
Green spells restore 5% more health, and Verdant Embrace has a 100% chance to grant Essence Burst.
Beast Mastery
Barbed Shot causes your pets to stomp one additional time at 50% effectiveness.
Stomp makes your next Cobra Shot benefit from Beast Cleave at 20% effectiveness or strike the primary target for 15% additional damage, stacking up to 4 times.
Marksmanship
Explosive Shot lasts 1 sec longer and deals 5% increased damage.
Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire damage increase by 5%; each Explosive Shot burst reduces their cooldown by 0.5 sec.
Survival
The source overview lists a 4-piece effect: each Boomstick blast extends Mongoose Fury by 1 sec and increases its effects by 10%.
Mongoose Fury also increases Wildfire Bomb damage by 10%.
Arcane
Arcane Missiles fires 1 additional Missile and deals 20% increased damage.
Each wave of Arcane Missiles increases the damage of your next Arcane Blast, Arcane Pulse, or Prismatic Bolt by 5%, up to 40%.
Fire
Pyroclasm causes Flamestrike and Pyroblast to always critically strike.
Pyroclasm reduces cast time of Flamestrike and Pyroblast by 20% and increases its damage bonus by 25%.
Frost
Each stack of Freezing Shattered has a 4% chance to generate an Icicle. Glacial Spike damage increased by 20%.
Casting Glacial Spike has a chance to rapidly generate 5 Icicles over 1 sec. Shatter damage increased by 5%.
Brewmaster
Breath of Fire ignites your next Keg Smash, adding Flamestrike damage to its primary target and reduced damage to others.
Ignited Keg Smashes cause enemies struck to take 8% increased damage from Physical abilities and leave flames dealing Fire damage for 5 sec.
Mistweaver
Rising Sun Kick deals 30% increased damage and Rushing Wind Kick healing is increased by 100%.
Rising Sun Kick and Rushing Wind Kick can make the next cast ignore its cooldown and reduce its mana cost by 100%.
Windwalker
Fists of Fury strikes an additional time at the start of its channel at 50% effectiveness.
Fists of Fury increases the damage of your next Rising Sun Kick by 10% or Spinning Crane Kick by 20% each strike, stacking up to 6 times.

pieces.name: Battle Gi of the Monkey King

specs: Holy
Infusion of Light increases Flash of Light healing and Greater Judgment absorb by an additional 100%.
Judgment has a 20% chance to grant Infusion of Light. Holy Light always grants it, but mana cost is increased by 50%.
Protection
Consecration is 30% larger and enemies inside are illuminated, increasing your abilities' critical strike chance against them by 5%.
Enemies struck by Judgment or Blessed Hammer / Hammer of the Righteous / Crusader Strike take additional Holy damage, increased further on critical strikes.
Retribution
Divine Purpose has an additional 10% chance to activate; consuming it grants Divine Power, increasing Holy damage by 10% for 12 sec.
Consuming Divine Purpose grants Divine Arbiter, empowering other Holy Power spenders to unleash an arbiter of light dealing Holy damage.
Discipline
Penance damage and healing increased by 20%. Casting Penance reduces Mind Blast cooldown by 2 sec.
After Mind Blast, your next Power Word: Shield or Void Shield absorbs 25% more damage.
Holy
Each target affected by Renew increases critical strike chance of spells and abilities by 2%, up to 6%.
Renew healing increased by 10%. Light's Resurgence always leaves Renew on the first target healed by Prayer of Mending.
Shadow
Tentacle Slam cooldown is reduced by 3 sec and its damage increased by 100%.
Tentacle Slam always grants a free use of Void Volley at 100% effectiveness.

pieces.name: Enveloping Legwraps of the Cosmic Penitent

specs: Assassination
Envenom damage increased by 10% and increases damage dealt by 3%.
Deadly Poison increases bleed damage on target by 10%; auto-attacks against Amplifying Poison targets deal 3% more damage per stack; Wound Poison hits twice.
Outlaw
Dispatch damage increased by 15%.
Sinister Strike and Ambush have a 20% chance to make next Dispatch free and deal maximum-combo-point damage.
Subtlety
Backstab costs 10 less Energy and deals 100% increased damage. Shuriken Storm costs 5 less Energy and deals 60% increased damage.
Lingering Shadow also benefits Eviscerate and Black Powder at 100% effectiveness.
Elemental
Earth Shock, Earthquake, and Elemental Blast damage increased by 25%.

When Stormkeeper or Ascendance fades, your next 2 Lightning Bolts, Chain Lightnings, or Lava Bursts deal 25% increased damage and your next Earthquake, Earth Shock, or Elemental Blast costs 100% less Maelstrom.
Enhancement
Voltaic Blaze causes your primary target to erupt in a Fire Nova every 2 sec for 6 sec; Fire Nova deals 200% increased damage to that target.
Fire Nova reduces Crash Lightning cooldown by 2 sec and increases the damage of your next Crash Lightning by 8%, stacking up to 5 times.
Restoration
Healing Wave and Chain Heal have a chance to create a Healing Rain at the target's location for 8 sec.
Each second, an ally inside Healing Rain gains a watery shield. The overview currently displays 0 absorption, so this effect's numeric tooltip requires verification.

specs: Affliction
Wither or Corruption damage increased by 25%. Agony damage increased by 15%.
Each active Unstable Affliction increases spell and ability damage by 2%, up to 6%. Seed of Corruption applies Unstable Affliction at 20% effectiveness.
Demonology
Wild Imp damage increased by 10%. Implosion damage increased by 20%.
When energy depletes, Wild Imps have a 20% chance to fling themselves at their target and Implode at 250% effectiveness to the main target and 225% to others.
Destruction
Incinerate damage increased by 25% and has a 10% increased chance to evoke an Echo of Sargeras.
Targets damaged by Echo of Sargeras take 6% increased damage from your spells and abilities for 6 sec.
Arms
Mortal Strike and Execute damage increased by 10%; Slam also deals damage to nearby enemies when you Slam a target.
Overpower damage increased by 15%. Mortal Strike and Overpower increase next Slam damage by 20%, stacking up to 5 times.
Fury
Raging Blow damage increased by 15%. During Recklessness, Raging Blow extends Recklessness by 2 sec, up to 6 sec.
Bloodthirst damage increased by 10%. During Recklessness, Bloodthirst increases Recklessness critical strike bonus by 5%, up to 10%.
Protection
Free Revenges deal 15% additional damage and cause your next Shield Slam to deal 20% additional damage.
Ravager and free Revenges cause targets to bleed over 12 sec. Ravager cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

The same item ID persists across the six item-level/appearance variants; exact item bonus IDs are not needed for set membership. Other class set pieces remain unverified and are not inferred.
